affinity.notes: The body and equipment are materially grounded; the small red weapon glow is subordinate and not elemental construction.

anatomy.notes: Slender humanoid pose, sword hand, and cape silhouette are clear.

archetype.notes: Assassin does not communicate the intended formal courtesy-duelist rule.

counterplay.notes: The prominently lowered blade and concentrated glowing tip identify the attack source and suggest a visible charge before a thrust.

finish.notes: Crisp tailoring, facial focus, and restrained red accents.

framing.notes: Full-body vertical composition gives the weapon and cloak room.

identity.notes: Vampire duelist identifies the Vampire Noble form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
